title: Cefpiramide Restricts Mycobacterium tuberculosis Growth by Binding to the DNA-Binding Domain of an Essential Response Regulator, MtrA.
authors: Rangaraj, Siranjeevi; Saxena, Shalini; Voina, Vidya Chitta; Mohareer, Krishnaveni; Banerjee, Sharmistha
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算筛选和分子动力学模拟发现头孢匹胺结合结核分枝杆菌反应调控因子MtrA的DNA结合域，破坏其DNA结合功能以抑制细菌生长，属于蛋白质-DNA互作（转录因子类）结合物理模拟方法，但对象非典型真核TF-DNA体系且侧重药物发现，故评6分。
abstract: The rise in drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M.tb) necessitates new therapeutic strategies. Hypothesizing that a single compound targeting multiple M.tb proteins would make resistance less likely to evolve, we focused on identifying a single compound targeting multiple M.tb OmpR family two-component response regulators (RRs). We screened  approximately 8000 FDA-approved DrugBank compounds using computational tools (active-site prediction, receptor-ligand docking, and molecular dynamics simulations) to identify one compound acting on M.tb RRs: MtrA, PrrA, MprA, RegX3, and PhoP. Cefpiramide showed strong docking scores and favorable interactions with all five RRs. Experimental validations confirmed that cefpiramide binds MtrA and RegX3 with K (b) values of 109.69 +/- 27.99 nM(-1) and 113.49 +/- 36.63 nM(-1), respectively. Further, the disruption of transcription repressor function of MtrA is possibly by disruption of its DNA binding property, as mutant analysis indicated that cefpiramide targets the DNA-binding domain of MtrA. Cefpiramide inhibited M.tb H37Rv growth (MIC(50) = 4 +/- 2.38 mug/mL), warranting further investigation as a component of combinatorial tuberculosis therapy.
abstract_zh: 耐药性结核分枝杆菌（M.tb）的增多 necessitates 新的治疗策略。假设单一化合物靶向多个M.tb蛋白会使耐药性更难演化，我们聚焦于识别一种能靶向多个M.tb OmpR家族双组分反应调控因子（RRs）的单一化合物。我们使用计算工具（活性位点预测、受体-配体对接和分子动力学模拟）筛选了约8000种FDA批准的DrugBank化合物，以识别一种作用于M.tb RRs的化合物：MtrA、PrrA、MprA、RegX3和PhoP。头孢匹胺（Cefpiramide）显示出强对接分数，并与所有五种RRs有有利相互作用。实验验证确认头孢匹胺与MtrA和RegX3结合，其K(b)值分别为109.69 ± 27.99 nM(-1)和113.49 ± 36.63 nM(-1)。此外，MtrA转录抑制因子功能的破坏可能通过破坏其DNA结合特性实现，因为突变体分析表明头孢匹胺靶向MtrA的DNA结合域。头孢匹胺抑制M.tb H37Rv生长（MIC(50) = 4 ± 2.38 μg/mL），值得进一步研究作为组合结核病疗法的组成部分。
